evidence.title: Counter with Evidence! A Multi-Agent Memory Efficient Reasoning Framework for Hate Category Informed Counterspeech Generation

summary: A new study proposes a memory-efficient, multi-agent reasoning system designed to produce informed counterspeech by leveraging evidence to combat hate speech. The framework aims to improve the effectiveness and scalability of AI-driven responses to online toxicity.
title: Researchers Introduce Multi-Agent AI Framework for Generating Evidence-Based Counterspeech Against Hate Speech
